purpose: Standard parcel intelligence window contract every county must fill before White Rabbit presents DCAD-like parcel cards outside Dallas.
uiConstraint: Do not redesign parcel windows. Add data behind the existing focused parcel card behavior.
parityRule: A non-Dallas county is not DCAD-parity until it has the same parcel intelligence feature groups as the Dallas DCAD model, or a field group is explicitly documented as verified unavailable with an approved county-specific equivalent. Source-needed placeholders are not parity.
texasRolloutRule: Every Texas county must move through this same contract before visible activation. Generic county shells may be queued, but they must remain do-not-activate until official sources, counts, join keys, viewport chunks, search shards, and QA are complete.

fieldGroups.label: Owner Contact
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: ACCOUNT_INFO OWNER_NAME1, OWNER_NAME2, BIZ_NAME, OWNER_ADDRESS_LINE*, OWNER_CITY, OWNER_STATE, OWNER_ZIPCODE, PHONE_NUM
fieldGroups.privacyRule: Never infer owner phone or email from permits, contractors, applicants, scraped pages, or non-owner public records.

fieldGroups.label: Geometry
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: PARCEL_GEOM.zip transformed into realGeometry, liveGeometry, centroid, points, viewport chunks

fieldGroups.label: Zoning
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: City of Dallas Public Zoning services joined by ACCT/GIS_ACCT first and spatial fallback second

fieldGroups.label: Floodplain
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: City of Dallas Current Floodplain parcel centroid spatial join

fieldGroups.label: Permits and Certificates
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: City of Dallas permits/CO normalized address match to DCAD parcels

fieldGroups.label: Migration and Demand
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: Not loaded in DCAD yet; national migration/demand layer remains a cross-county source-needed layer

fieldGroups.label: Source Lineage and QA
fieldGroups.dcadSourceExample: DCAD reports in output/ lock counts, join keys, missing geometry, duplicate keys, and unmatched joins

activationGate: Required field groups must have official county source paths.
Parcel geometry count and parcel/account row counts must be exact.
Primary join key must be documented and tested.
Owner/contact data must come from owner/appraisal sources, not permits or contractor records.
Viewport chunks and search shards must exist before browser activation.
County QC must pass before the county is enabled in the app.
